size.evidence: The official South Sudan Embassy in Washington DC website (ssembassydc.org/visa-services/) explicitly states 'Two (2) passport-sized photo (2 inches by 2 inches)'. This is independently corroborated by visa-to-travel.com which confirms '2x2 inches (51x51 mm)' for South Sudan visa photos. Multiple sources consistently agree on the 2x2 inch requirement.
